title: psephellus leuzeoides
intro: Psephellus leuzeoides, commonly known as Leuze's dandelion or Mountain Leuze's dandelion, is a plant species in the sunflower family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Psephellus leuzeoides include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
